title: Restore the catalog assistant on the updated AI SDK
prompt: The catalog assistant's AI SDK dependency has been updated. Restore its documented tool-assisted answering behavior and make the TypeScript build pass, editing src/ only. Preserve the public API, model injection, catalog lookup, audit callbacks and bounded model steps. Do not change the installed dependencies, configuration or tests.
notes_private: Actual breaks: experimental_prepareStep is removed (ignored at runtime, invalid in types) and ToolCallOptions is no longer exported. stepCountIs remains a deprecated working alias, NOT a required breaking-change fix; experimental_telemetry also still exists. Reference uses prepareStep, ToolExecutionOptions<unknown> and optionally modern isStepCount. Hidden tests invoke installed tsc --noEmit and ai/test MockLanguageModelV3.
